## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and the main implementation areas.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run e2e`
- [ ] `npm run launch:check`
- [ ] SEO / accessibility / security impact reviewed when applicable

## Build Vibe release notes

- [ ] Documentation updated and no superseded versioned entrypoints remain
- [ ] New template or feature has coverage
- [ ] `npm run final:check` passes when the change affects release/runtime behavior
- [ ] No secrets or generated runtime state committed

## Visual and generated-product quality checklist

For changes touching generated sites, design systems, animation or 3D, confirm that the [reconstruction plan](../docs/BUILD_VIBE_RECONSTRUCTION_MASTER_PLAN.md) was considered, responsive/accessibility behavior was tested, reduced-motion/fallback behavior was addressed, and claims match evidence. Preserve existing verification and security gates.
